title: Conversation 2026-11-04: exposing the registry on a network — REST, authentication, multi-user, SQL

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content: The owner noted that srs-rust now has a registry serving several repositories over MCP only, designed to run locally, and that the work is drifting toward exposing it on a network. They asked whether a REST API has value beside MCP, whether an authentication layer is needed and can be added without bloat while keeping the sovereign principles, and whether multi-user access forces an SQL backend. They asked for research toward the roadmap, with experiments and dogfooding in srs-lab that must not undermine the system.
